message:
Yes, T-Netix and Evercom are both subsidiaries of Securus. MCI probably didn't know of the switch, but the Wisconsin Department of Corrections and other portions of the state government certainly did. Yet again, Securus and its subsidiaries get you to pay twice for phone calls: once through your taxes, which go through the government and the Department of Corrections to Securus, and once through your phone bill. It's a monopoly funded by your state government, it's a state-sponsored way for corporate vultures to profit from the suffering of inmates' loved ones, and it ought to be illegal.

Jai, call your congressman. Call your senator. Call your governor. And ask why the hell this is allowed to continue in a democracy.
